item_name: Rothco Vintage Veteran Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Veteran Low Profile Cap is designed for veterans to display their pride with style and comfort. Featuring raised embroidered text for Air Force, Marines, or Navy veterans on both the front panel and back strap, this cap lets you show your service affiliation prominently. The woven American flag label on the front panel adds a patriotic touch, enhancing the cap's overall appeal. Crafted from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, this cap offers ideal comfort and durability.
description: Rothco’s Vintage Veteran Low Profile Cap is designed for veterans to display their pride with style and comfort. Featuring raised embroidered text for Air Force, Marines, or Navy veterans on both the front panel and back strap, this cap lets you show your service affiliation prominently. The woven American flag label on the front panel adds a patriotic touch, enhancing the cap's overall appeal. Crafted from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, this cap offers ideal comfort and durability. The adjustable hook & loop strap closure ensures a perfect fit for most head sizes. Vent holes in the cap allow heat to escape, keeping you cool, while the internal sweatband absorbs moisture for added comfort. Whether you're a veteran of the Air Force, Marines, or Navy, Rothco’s Vintage Veteran Low Profile Cap is the perfect way to proudly display your service. With its thoughtful design and quality construction, this cap is a must-have for any veteran looking to combine comfort with a proud display of their service. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
